info.description: Unstable contract for product 0.x: breaking changes ship in place, each with a `breaking` changelog fragment.

get.summary: Current and expected database schema version (read-only).

current.description: Identifier of the last applied migration, or null when no database is reachable or none was applied.

expected.description: Identifier of the last migration this build ships, or null before the data model exists.

upToDate.description: True when the database is at exactly the migration this build expects.

SchemaStatus.description:
The database schema as the API sees it (E82.5): the migration the database is at and the one this build
expects. Read-only; applying migrations is a bootstrap step outside the API (`wms migrate`).
